summary: Tested 3 new features in NETRA ERP Sales Module: 1) AI-powered note suggestion endpoint (GPT-5.2 via Emergent LLM), 2) Updated funnel completion checklists with correct mandatory fields, 3) Grouped-by-client follow-up view. All backend tests passed (14/14). All frontend features verified working.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 3 features verified working: 1) POST /api/ai/suggest endpoint works with context_type='mom', 'follow_up', 'next_steps' - returns polished text suggestions using GPT-5.2 via emergentintegrations library. Returns 400 when both rough_text and additional_context are empty. Requires auth. 2) GET /api/leads/{id}/funnel-checklist returns updated requirements: pricing_plan shows 'At least one team member added', 'Total investment entered (> 0)', 'Payment start date set'; record_meeting shows 'Meeting date & time set', 'MOM summary filled'; agreement shows 'Milestones added with amounts'; scope_of_work shows 'At least one scope item with title'. 3) Follow-ups page has 'By Client' grouped view as default with collapsible client groups showing open/closed badges. View toggle between 'By Client' and 'Table' modes works. AI Suggest button appears in Create Follow-up dialog next to Notes field. MeetingRecord page has AI Suggest buttons next to Meeting Notes, MOM Summary, and Next Steps fields.
